_comment: Google OAuth clients for the native builds. The web build does not use this file - it signs in through Firebase's popup. See SYNC.md for how to create these. Neither value here is confidential: RFC 8252 section 8.5 is explicit that an installed app's client secret cannot be kept secret, which is why PKCE protects the exchange instead.

desktop._type: Google Cloud Console -> Credentials -> OAuth client ID -> Desktop app

android._type: Google Cloud Console -> Credentials -> OAuth client ID -> Android. Package name com.msec.vault, plus the SHA-1 fingerprint of the keystore you made with new-keystore.ps1. Android clients have no secret.
